_readme: Set 'plan' to your actual subscription tier. The script resolves budget and
resetCycle from plan defaults. Override 'budget' explicitly to customise.
Claude resets DAILY  (rolling ~5 h window — tracked here per UTC day).
Codex  resets WEEKLY (Monday UTC — tracked here per ISO week).
These are different reset cycles because the two providers work differently.
Do not try to track both on the same cycle.
_hookCost: The Claude Code Stop hook that calls quota-check.mjs is a LOCAL shell process.
It reads one JSON file, writes one JSON file, and prints conditionally.
ZERO API calls. ZERO network traffic. ZERO tokens consumed.
Cost: a few milliseconds of disk I/O after each response.

claude._budgetOverride: Optional. Set 'budget' to override the plan default (e.g. budget: 80).
claude._note: resetCycle is always 'daily' for Claude — do not change this.

codex._budgetOverride: Optional. Set 'budget' to override the plan default (e.g. budget: 8).
codex._note: resetCycle is always 'weekly' for Codex — do not change this.
